entries.title: Numbers 27:1
segments: And the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh, the son of Joseph came. And these [are] the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

entries.title: Numbers 27:2
segments: And they stood before Moses and before Eleazar the priest, and before the rulers and all the congregation, [by] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 27:3
segments: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of those who gathered themselves against the LORD in the company of Korah, but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

entries.title: Numbers 27:4
segments: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he has no son? Therefore give us a possession among the brothers of our father.

entries.title: Numbers 27:5
segments: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 27:6
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 27:7
segments: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brothers. And you shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

entries.title: Numbers 27:8
segments: And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, When a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

entries.title: Numbers 27:9
segments: And if he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

entries.title: Numbers 27:10
segments: And if he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers.

entries.title: Numbers 27:11
segments: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his nearest relative, of his family, and he shall possess it. And it shall be to the sons of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Numbers 27:12
segments: And the LORD said to Moses, Get up into this Mount Abarim and see the land which I have given to the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 27:13
segments: And when you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people as Aaron your brother was gathered.

entries.title: Numbers 27:14
segments: For you rebelled against My command in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify Me at the water before their eyes; they [were] the Waters of Strife in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

entries.title: Numbers 27:15
segments: And Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 27:16
segments: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation

entries.title: Numbers 27:17
segments: who may go out before them, and who may go in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, so that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.

entries.title: Numbers 27:18
segments: And the LORD said to Moses, Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom [is] the Spirit, and lay your hand upon him.

entries.title: Numbers 27:19
segments: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation, and give him a charge in their sight.

entries.title: Numbers 27:20
segments: And you shall put of your honor on him, so that all the congregation of the sons of Israel may be obedient.

entries.title: Numbers 27:21
segments: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask for him according to the judgment of Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, he and all the sons of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

entries.title: Numbers 27:22
segments: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him. And he took Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

entries.title: Numbers 27:23
segments: And he laid his hands upon him and gave him a charge, even as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
